SJ13-09.name: The ExertedBrave Saikyo-King
SJ13-09.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Charge]
Increase the number of bodies to be refreshed by your “Spirit-refreshing effects” by +1.

[LV2] (When Battles)
For each "Armed Machine" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

SJ13-08.name: The FriendlyRobo Saikyo-Leon
SJ13-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Yellow Core]: Return a Cost 2 Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

SJ13-26.name: Pharaon
SJ13-26.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

SJ13-24.name: The CraneScythe Kuroduru
SJ13-24.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +2000 BP.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
If you control any Bunshin spirit, the opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.

SJ13-25.name: The NinjaArtsBird Ginrai
SJ13-25.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Bunshin: 1] (When Summoned)
By placing one card from your decktop onto the Field facedown and putting at least one core from the Reserve on it, until the end of the game, it is treated as "Cost 0/"Bunshin" family/LV1: 1 core, 3000 BP/[Green Core]" Green Bunshin Spirits. (Bunshin Spirits can't be braved, and are discarded when returned to the Hand/Deck.)

SJ13-01.name: The TwinFlameBlade Blaze-Edge
SJ13-01.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Destroy two opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits.

SJ13-02.name: Weaponmaster-Dragon
SJ13-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When this effect summons any "Exalted Sword" family Brave, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
